comparisons.peer_summary: Data Center net revenue increased 94% to $12.6 billion in 2024 from $6.5 billion in 2023, primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs. Operating income rose to $3.5 billion in 2024 from $1.3 billion in 2023, mainly due to higher revenue partially offset by increased R&D investment.
comparisons.comparison: While Intel explicitly defines its competitive landscape including AMD, NVIDIA, and custom silicon vendors (Intel: 'Our competitors include hardware vendors such as AMD that compete with us across the full spectrum of CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, and other products...'), AMD focuses on its own market performance rather than listing competitors. AMD's disclosure highlights that its Data Center revenue increased 94% in 2024, primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs (AMD: 'Data Center net revenue of $12.6 billion in 2024 increased by 94%... primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs'), confirming the competitive product areas (CPUs and GPUs/Accelerators) mentioned in Intel's competitive overview.

sentences.text: Our competitors include hardware vendors such as AMD that compete with us across the full spectrum of CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, and other products; providers of GPU systems such as NVIDIA; companies developing their own custom silicon; and new entrants and incumbents developing ARM- and RISC-V-based products customized for specific data center workloads.
Data Center net revenue of $12.6 billion in 2024 increased by 94%, compared to net revenue of $6.5 billion in 2023.
The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs.

comparisons.peer_topic: Global Technology Scope and Product Portfolio
comparisons.peer_summary: Avago is a global technology leader designing semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, including AI networking, home connectivity, and software for mainframe and cloud platforms, while also offering fibre channel storage area networking products.
comparisons.comparison: Intel describes a competitive landscape including hardware vendors and companies developing custom silicon for data center workloads. Broadcom (Avago) discloses that it supplies semiconductor solutions used in 'enterprise and data center networking, including artificial intelligence ("AI") networking and connectivity' and 'data center servers and storage systems'. Both disclosures identify AI and data center infrastructure as critical market segments, though Intel frames it through the lens of competitor identification while Broadcom frames it through product application scope.

comparisons.peer_topic: Data Center customer segments and automotive demand outlook
comparisons.peer_summary: In the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024, large cloud providers represented more than half of Data Center revenue. Additionally, the company expects NVIDIA's automotive data center processing demand to grow significantly as AV algorithms shift to video transformers.
comparisons.comparison: Intel identifies NVIDIA as a key competitor providing 'GPU systems' and highlights the evolution of the data center landscape. NVIDIA's disclosure supports this competitive context by detailing its Data Center revenue composition, noting that in Q4 FY2024, 'large cloud providers represented more than half of our Data Center revenue, supporting both internal workloads and external customers.' This illustrates the specific market segment (cloud/data center) where NVIDIA competes with Intel's CPU and accelerator offerings.
